paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文提出 Vision Transformer（ViT），将图像切分为固定大小的图像块序列，直接输入标准 Transformer 编码器进行图像分类，尽可能少地引入图像特有的归纳偏置 [S1.p3][S5.p1]。作者在 ImageNet、ImageNet-21k 和 JFT-300M 等不同规模数据集上预训练，并迁移到多个图像识别基准 [S4.SS1.p1]。结果显示，在中小数据集上 ViT 不如同规模 ResNet，但在大规模数据预训练后，ViT 在多个基准上达到或超过当时最优卷积网络，且预训练计算资源更少 [S1.p4][S1.p5][S4.SS2.p2]。作者认为这表明对 CNN 的依赖并非必要，纯 Transformer 可直接用于图像分类 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络结构。原文指出，在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，此前将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与 CNN 结合，要么替换 CNN 的某些组件但保留整体结构 [S1.p2][abstract]。作者受 NLP 中 Transformer 成功与可扩展性的启发，尝试以尽可能少的修改把标准 Transformer 直接用于图像 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: We show that this reliance on CNNs is not necessary and a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks.
In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
Inspired by NLP successes, multiple works try combining CNN-like architectures with self-attention, some replacing the convolutions entirely.
Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.

method.text: ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的二维图像块，展平后经可训练线性投影映射为 patch embeddings，并加入位置嵌入，形成序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.F1]。模型沿用 BERT 式的可学习 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个块前使用 LayerNorm、块后使用残差连接 [S3.SS1.p4]。微调时移除预训练预测头，接零初始化前馈层，并可在更高分辨率下对预训练位置嵌入做 2D 插值 [S3.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
The Transformer encoder consists of alternating layers of multiheaded self-attention (MSA, see Appendix A) and MLP blocks
Layernorm (LN) is applied before every block, and residual connections after every block.
we remove the pre-trained prediction head and attach a zero-initialized $D\times K$ feedforward layer
We therefore perform 2D interpolation of the pre-trained position embeddings, according to their location in the original image.

experiments.text: 作者在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型大小与图像块大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。基线 CNN 使用将 BatchNorm 替换为 GroupNorm 的 ResNet（ResNet (BiT)），混合模型将 CNN 特征图输入 ViT [S4.SS1.p4]。训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD with momentum、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。

evidence.quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images.

We transfer the models trained on these dataset to several benchmark tasks: ImageNet on the original validation labels and the cleaned-up ReaL labels, CIFAR-10/100, Oxford-IIIT Pets, and Oxford Flowers-102.
We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.
For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
For the hybrids, we feed the intermediate feature maps into ViT with patch size of one “pixel”.
We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096 and apply a high weight decay of $0.1$
For fine-tuning we use SGD with momentum, batch size 512, for all models

findings.text: 在中小数据集上，ViT 在 ImageNet 上比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，作者认为这是因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置 [S1.p4]。但在大规模数据预训练后，ViT-L/16 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后在所有任务上超过同样在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 BiT-L，且计算资源更少；ViT-H/14 进一步提升，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务上 77.63% [S1.p5]。在 VTAB 分组中，ViT-H/14 在 Natural 和 Structured 任务上超过 BiT-R152x4 等方法，在 Specialized 上前两名模型表现相近 [S4.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality
The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
The larger model, ViT-H/14, further improves the performance, especially on the more challenging datasets – ImageNet, CIFAR-100, and the VTAB suite.
the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
ViT-H/14 outperforms BiT-R152x4, and other methods, on the Natural and Structured tasks.
On the Specialized the performance of the top two models is similar.

limitations.text: 作者指出，ViT 在中小数据集上不如同规模 ResNet，因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化不好 [S1.p4]。在较小数据集上，Vision Transformer 比同计算量的 ResNet 更容易过拟合 [S4.SS3.p3]。作者还承认，将 ViT 应用到检测和分割等其他视觉任务仍是挑战，自监督预训练与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距，且进一步扩展 ViT 可能带来性能提升 [S5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
Vision Transformers overfit more than ResNets with comparable computational cost on smaller datasets.
One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
Our initial experiments show improvement from self-supervised pre-training, but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training.
Finally, further scaling of ViT would likely lead to improved performance.
